name: vault_deposit
summary: Put ingots, ores and ices straight into an Ingot Vault's store from wherever they are, with the vault's own bookkeeping; by id, in part, or by a filter over the world. Dry run by default; confirm to do it.

help.text: Each item is added to the store (an ingot's reagents times its grams; an ore's or ice's count) and destroyed, or only the part asked is taken off a stack. The vault's rule decides what it takes: ingots and ores (ices, slag and organics are ores) whose slot class fits its import slot. Host only.

forms.text: items [{reference_id, quantity}] (up to 256; quantity a whole count for ores, grams for ingots), reference_ids (whole items), or a filter over every item in the world: prefab_contains, name_contains, location, within_id, near_player_m, kind and limit (default 256, max 1000, nearest the player first). Items the vault does not take are left out of a filter and counted as skipped.

reply.text: {dry_run, vault, via (the Remote Vault used), matched, skipped, truncated, items {results [{index, ok, reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, kind, from {id, slot}, quantity, left_in_source}], count, success_count, error_count}, stock [{kind, prefab_name, display_name, reagent, before, change, after}]}. A real run reads after back from the vault. A refused item: thing_not_found, not_vault_material, no_reagents, in_vault_slot, slot_locked, invalid_argument (more than the stack holds, part of an ore, an item named twice).

vault_id.description: The Ingot Vault, or a Remote Vault linked to one.

quantity.description: Part of the stack: a whole count of ore, grams of ingot. Default all.

items.description: Items by id, each whole or in part, up to 256.

prefab_contains.description: Filter: part of the prefab name, any case.

name_contains.description: Filter: part of the shown name, any case.

location.description: Filter: any, ground, player or stored (see items).

within_id.description: Filter: inside this holder at any depth (a backpack, a locker, a player).

near_player_m.description: Filter: within this many metres of the player.

kind.description: Filter: ingot, ore (not ice), ice, or any. Default any.

limit.description: Filter: at most this many items, nearest first; default 256.

dry_run.description: Default true: check and report only.

confirm.description: true with dry_run false to deposit.
